name: security
description: Password strength (zxcvbn) and breach check (Have I Been Pwned range API - only 5 characters of a hash leave the PC), file/folder encryption to AES-256 7z and decryption, and a credential vault in Windows Credential Manager. Secrets typed here are masked in history, the saved chat and memory.
route: password strength, has a password been leaked in a breach, encrypt or decrypt a file with a password, save or read a login from the credential vault
